verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that BugSnag's client SDK (bugsnag-js) is hosted on GitHub. No license is stated anywhere in the pack, and nothing shows the BugSnag service itself is source-available. The On-premise offering is self-hosting, not open source. A public SDK repo with no evidenced open license does not deliver reading the product's source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
